integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, magical-realist with an absurdist streak: a low rear-angle medium-wide shot on a black ice crust under a dense field of white stars, the buggy's red tail lights still burning behind him. A traveler with silver hair and a long black hooded cloak, his face never visible, hops down from the buggy, plants both boots and holds still for a beat while the cloak settles, then turns his back fully to the camera and takes two measured steps toward a slender rocket standing ahead in the dark. The camera swings out of the rear angle into a slow half-circle orbit to the left at belly height, keeping his back and silver hair centered. Ice dust skitters across the ground in the growing wind and the sky darkens by one stop. A low engine hum rises under the wind. [Shot 2] At 00:03.200, the camera cuts to a low wide shot beside the rocket's base as the traveler hooks a rung, hauls himself up the rungs two at a time, cloak flaring wide, and swings a leg over the hull to sit astride the rocket, gripping the casing; exhaust glow floods up from below and rims the black fabric. [Shot 3] At 00:05.400, the camera cuts to a static wide shot as the rocket punches up through frame with the traveler riding astride it, the plume blowing the crust wide, and the orbit settles into a hold on the empty ice with Mars burning low ahead and the buggy's silhouette small at the edge of frame, the rider shrinking toward the red disc.

overall_soundscape: A thin wind drags ice dust over hard crust, boot soles crunch down, and heavy fabric snaps in the gusts. Metal rungs ring under gloved hands, a hatch thumps, then a deep ignition roar swells and tears upward, thinning out into high, empty wind over the frozen ground.

non_diegetic_music: A sustained low synth drone with slow kettle-drum strikes, building into a brass swell at the launch, then decaying into a single high shimmering tone as the rocket shrinks into the distance.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, magical-realist with an absurdist streak: a low rear-angle wide shot on a pale grey lunar plain, hard rim light cutting across the ridges while a colossal rust-red Mars with dark banded canyons fills the upper half of the black sky. The traveler — slight build, white hair, long black cloak with a flared hem — stands on the crest with his back to camera, watching a slim rocket climb on a column of white-pink exhaust. The camera tilts up with small amplitude at slow speed until the rocket is a single point of light against the planet. [Shot 2] At 00:03.200, the camera cuts to a wide shot on an ochre Martian plain ridged with long dunes, the same white-haired traveler in the same black cloak riding a low open buggy that tears forward along a straight dust track, twin plumes rolling off the wheels, a pale low sun behind him. The camera tracks right with small amplitude at slow speed alongside the buggy. [Shot 3] At 00:05.800, the camera cuts to a medium-wide shot: the buggy stops, dust settles, and the traveler steps down; across from him stand four short round-bellied Martians with copper-green skin, oversized bald heads and three-fingered hands, wrapped in tattered silver thermal blankets. The tallest one, with a buzzy nasal voice that clicks on every consonant (S1), steps forward and says: <d>[English] You are late.</d> while holding out a single steaming potato on a dented tin plate; the traveler's cloak settles around his ankles and he does not move.

overall_soundscape: A deep rocket roar fades into a thin wind hiss over the lunar plain, then gives way to the crunch of wheels grinding through Martian dust. The buggy engine cuts, a soft metallic click of three-fingered hands on tin follows, and a faint steam hiss rises from the plate.

non_diegetic_music: A slow sparse synth drone in a minor key, joined by one plucked string and a soft low pulse that thins out and stops on the final beat.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, magical-realist with an absurdist epic streak: a worm's-eye extreme low-angle shot sits right under the chassis of the yellow-wheeled rover on the desert highway, sand spitting between the tires toward the lens. The silver-haired traveler in the black cloak walks into frame from the left, back to the camera and face unseen, while the four bald ochre-skinned aliens in shiny silver quilted blankets sprint alongside the rover, metal bowls raised. The camera tracks left with small amplitude at slow speed, hugging the axle as grit streaks across the frame. [Shot 2] At 00:03.100, the camera cuts to a wide low shot from behind the traveler as he plants a boot on the rover's roll bar and vaults onto the hood; an alien hurls its bowl like a discus and the traveler ducks, the bowl shearing the air past his shoulder. The camera whips into a fast arc shot with large amplitude around the rover as dust obscures the rear wheels. [Shot 3] At 00:05.700, the camera cuts to a high wide shot pulling out from the highway as the rover careens off the asphalt and all four aliens are dragged behind in a flapping silver bundle, the traveler balanced on the roof with his cloak streaming. The camera pulls out with large amplitude at slow speed until dunes, road and the tiny wreck settle into a single epic golden frame.

overall_soundscape: Engines rattle and tires churn sand in continuous sheets, mixed with the clatter of metal bowls and snapping silver fabric. Boots thud on sheet metal and a spray of grit hisses past, while thin alien squeals rise and fall with the chase.

non_diegetic_music: Hand percussion and clapping in a fast comedic gallop, undercut by a full brass section that swells at the vault and resolves on one long held chord at the pull-out.

story.logline: 一个提着灯的青年走遍森林、石像、长河与山巅去寻找真理，直到灯灭之夜发现光一直在他掌心，于是他回到村庄把光分给别人。
story.style: painterly storybook illustration, soft volumetric light, muted teal and amber palette, matte gouache texture, gentle film grain, cinematic composition

beats.title: 晨雾出发
beats.action: 天刚亮，提灯的青年离开村口踏上苔藓小径，越走越深，村舍在雾里消失。
beats.image: young wanderer with short black hair, patched indigo wool coat, canvas satchel, brass lantern swinging in right hand, stepping onto a mossy forest path, thatched village roofs fading in mist behind him, low angle wide shot, amber dawn light through birch trunks, volumetric fog, swinging lantern glow on wet moss, painterly storybook illustration, matte gouache texture, 35mm lens
beats.video: he walks away from camera at a steady pace, coat and lantern swinging gently, camera slowly pushes forward through the fog following his back, dawn light brightens and mist thins to reveal deeper forest, ends on his small silhouette continuing down the path

beats.title: 石像不答
beats.action: 青年在环形废墟里举灯仰问覆满青苔的巨像，石像空洞的双眼毫无回应。
beats.image: the same wanderer standing small before a colossal moss-covered stone statue with hollow empty eyes, ruined circular shrine with broken dome, he looks up raising his brass lantern, shafts of white daylight falling through the opening, drifting dust motes, low angle medium shot, cool grey-green stone against warm lantern glow, painterly storybook illustration, matte gouache texture, 50mm lens
beats.video: he lifts the lantern higher toward the statue's face and waits, moss sways slightly in a draft while the statue stays perfectly still, camera slowly cranes up from his upturned face to the statue's hollow eyes, light flickers and dust drifts through the beam, ends holding on the empty eyes with him tiny at the bottom of frame

beats.title: 河水照影
beats.action: 午后河边，青年跪在水边问长河，河水只推来一圈圈涟漪打碎他的倒影。
beats.image: the same wanderer kneeling at the edge of a wide slow river in golden afternoon, hands on knees, brass lantern set beside him on the pebbles, his mirrored reflection in the still water, tall reeds, distant blue hills, wide shot from low water level, warm backlight through reeds, ripples breaking the mirror, painterly storybook illustration, matte gouache texture, 35mm lens
beats.video: he leans down toward the water and his breath ripples the surface, camera drifts slowly sideways along the waterline, the reflection breaks apart and reforms then scatters again, sunlight lowers and warms, ends on the disturbed water holding only fragments of his face
beats.line: 你流了千年，你见过它吗？

beats.title: 山巅问星
beats.action: 夜里青年登上峰顶，对着漫天星海转圈发问，云层滑过星群，没有人回答。
beats.image: the same wanderer small on a rocky summit at night, arms slightly open, brass lantern dim at his side, vast field of stars and a slow milky way river overhead, jagged black peaks below, extreme wide shot, cold blue moonlight rim light on his indigo coat, deep shadows, painterly storybook illustration, matte gouache texture, 24mm lens
beats.video: he turns in a slow circle addressing the sky, coat flaring, camera pulls back and tilts up from him into the star field, thin clouds slide over the stars and moonlight dims, ends with him a tiny figure under the enormous silent sky

beats.title: 灯灭悟心
beats.action: 灯焰熄灭，黑暗里青年合掌，掌心自己亮起一小团暖光，映亮他的眼。
beats.image: the same wanderer sitting cross-legged on the summit rock in near darkness, hands cupped at his chest cradling a small warm glow, dead brass lantern tipped beside him, close-up three-quarter shot, single warm light source on his tired young face, deep blue night behind, painterly storybook illustration, matte gouache texture, 85mm lens
beats.video: the lantern flame shrinks and dies, darkness closes in, he slowly cups his hands and a soft warm glow blooms between his palms and rises to light his face, camera pushes in gently to his eyes, ends on a small smile lit only by his own hands

beats.title: 归村传灯
beats.action: 黎明时分青年回到村口，把灯高高举起，光和晨雾一起铺开在村人脸上。
beats.image: the same wanderer back at the village gate at dawn, holding his glowing brass lantern high, village children and an old woman gathering toward him, thin morning mist, thatched roofs and low stone wall, warm lantern glow against pale blue dawn, wide shot from slightly low, painterly storybook illustration, matte gouache texture, 35mm lens
beats.video: he raises the lantern and its warm light spreads across the villagers' upturned faces as they step closer, camera pulls back and rises slowly over the village, dawn colors warm the sky and small lights answer from the windows, ends on a wide dawn village glowing point by point
beats.line: 真理不在远方，就在举灯的手里。
